name: Multi-LogiEval
intro: Multi-LogiEval 评测命题逻辑、一阶逻辑与非单调逻辑的一至五步推理。论文分别构造经典逻辑与非单调逻辑规则组合，用 Claude-2 生成自然语言上下文和问题，经人工逐条校验修订后保留 1,552 条数据，并以零样本思维链完成二元蕴含分类。
org: Arizona State University, Google, Intel, UCSF
build_method: 规则组合, 自动生成, 人工校验, 混合
task_type: 二元分类, 逻辑蕴含
eval_feature: 三类逻辑, 深度 1–5, 规则组合, 人工修订, 零样本思维链
build_method_en: Rule Composition, Automated Generation, Human Validation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Three Logic Types, Depths 1–5, Rule Combinations, Human Correction, Zero-shot CoT
intro_en: Multi-LogiEval evaluates one-to-five-step reasoning across propositional, first-order, and non-monotonic logic. The paper separately composes classical and non-monotonic rule chains, uses Claude-2 to generate natural-language contexts and questions, manually validates and corrects every item, retains 1,552 examples, and evaluates binary entailment with zero-shot CoT.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.17169 Section 3 and Appendices B–F plus the official Multi-LogiEval repository. The diagrams preserve separate PL/FOL and non-monotonic streams, depth-one rules, conclusion-to-premise chaining, 71 monotonic combinations, eight NM patterns and 12/2/2/1 depth-wise combinations, Claude-2 few-shot generation, naturalization, manual logic and language correction, the exact 1,552 total with logic/depth/label distributions, six-model zero-shot-CoT binary entailment, Accuracy by logic and depth, and reasoning-chain analysis.
